confidence_notes: Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors are corroborated by several aggregator pages and one venue-level menu, but some are dated (one source last updated 2023) and crowd-sourced. Cocktail is moderately supported; wine_glass is the weakest food anchor because no reliable 2026 Bratislava per-glass restaurant price was found, so it is a bounded estimate. EUR-denominated figures were converted to USD. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July 2026, not checked against live booking pages or current listings, and they may vary by season and location.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink levels were benchmarked against Bratislava-specific aggregator figures and sense-checked against Vienna and Munich comparisons, which show Bratislava well below Western Austrian and German levels. Accommodation uses holistic judgement against mid-sized Central European capitals with similar July tourism demand, with no direct per-listing comparison.
